summary: Quiet residential kerb with other cars parked, but houses 14 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwelling 14 m away on the section's side, others 22-24 m; heavy canopy screens the street.

drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street just below a roundabout; light local traffic.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked along the kerb in both images, so a van would blend in.

flags: 1P parallel and school-day bus zone signs on this kerb
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over most of the stretch, mostly shaded.
cannot_judge: Exact room to pass a parked van
